last_tests.command: Post-write fetch verification of dataset evaluator and mobile lab
last_tests.result: Evaluator imports labeled PLANT/NON_PLANT image files, decodes locally, runs existing evidence+gate pipeline, preserves INVALID separately, and reports pass/reject/uncertain counts. Dataset Lab requires both classes and explicitly refuses to present absent corpus as metrics.
last_tests.scope: runtime harness structural verification; no real-photo accuracy claim

Species recognition remains intentionally disabled until subject reject is validated on real images
